I’m not a medical professional, just trying to learn the body better so maybe the app is more for people who already have information. But so far, there are a couple of things I wish to see in the future. 1) The animation videos. After opening an animation from the animation screen, the back button takes you to the 3D model forcing you to open the animation menu each time you want to switch videos. It would be more user friendly if the back button took you to the previous tab you had open. 1.5) I wish the animation videos had a legend or something similar. The muscles change color, but it doesn’t say what the color change means. 2) As someone who bought the app to try to learn about the body, it would be awesome if there was an information window for each of the body parts that mentioned what its function is and what role it plays in the body so that I don't have to leave the app every time I want to know what something does. Such as clicking on an information icon on the pituitary gland, it could say, “The pituitary gland controls the involuntary nervous system and regulates growth, metabolism, and reproduction hormones” or something. It would also be nice to see causal terms listed as well such as “tympanic membrane (eardrum)” I do recognize someone with my lack of knowledge may not be the targeted audience for the app, but it would be wonderful to see a little more information within the app.
